prompt: Can you generate release notes for both the Google Play Store (Indonesian) and App Store (English) based on the latest version in CHANGELOG.md?
assertions: The opening paragraph in the ID section is written in Indonesian and is at least 150 characters long
The opening paragraph in the EN section is written in English and is at least 150 characters long
The ID section contains no more than 5 bullet points
The EN section contains no more than 5 bullet points
The Indonesian bullet items are written in natural Indonesian (not word-for-word translated English)
